who_guidance.text: WHO adult public-health guidance recommends 150–300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75–150 minutes of vigorous activity (or an equivalent combination) per week, plus muscle-strengthening activity involving major muscle groups on at least two days. These are population health targets, not an athlete's complete conditioning prescription. [S02] [S10]

concurrent_training.text: Concurrent training: cardio and resistance training can coexist. Schedule high-intensity endurance and demanding lower-body lifting with enough separation or sequencing to preserve quality when performance is important. The magnitude of interference depends on modality, dose, training status, scheduling and outcome; avoid absolute claims that cardio 'kills gains'.
